tables.tenant_invitations: An invitation for a person to join the tenant by email. Only the hash of the secret link is stored.
tables.tenants: The organization that owns all data. The current deployment holds exactly one tenant.
tables.audit_event: One audit record for a sign-in, an account change, an access change or an administrative action.
tables.actors: A user account or a service account inside MemoryOS.
tables.tenant_memberships: Links a user to the tenant with a role and an active or inactive status.
tables.iam_groups: A group of members. Permissions, sources, models, meetings and MCP servers are given to groups.
tables.external_identity_bindings: Maps a Keycloak account (issuer and subject) to a MemoryOS user. MemoryOS stores no passwords.
tables.iam_group_memberships: Puts a member in a group and marks the group managers.
tables.iam_group_capability_grants: One permission that a group gives to its members.
tables.actor_profiles: The name and email last received from the sign-in provider.
tables.google_drive_sources: Settings that only a Google Drive source has.
tables.sharepoint_sources: Settings that only a SharePoint source has.
tables.lark_sources: Marks a source as a Lark source. Lark needs no extra settings.
tables.credentials: The secret that a source uses to read a platform. The secret itself is encrypted in a table for each platform.
tables.source_group_grants: Gives one group access to the documents of one source.
tables.connector_credential_pairs: A Source as the user sees it: one connector with one credential, its access mode and its sync status.
tables.connectors: The platform type and name behind a source.
tables.connector_items: One file or page found in a source, with its latest version.
tables.document_set_source: Adds a source to a document set.
tables.index_attempts: One attempt to index one item version. The worker claims it with a lease and records the result.
tables.documents_by_connector_credential_pair: Links a document to the source and item it came from, and says whether search may return it.
tables.connector_item_versions: One saved version of an item. The file itself is in object storage.
tables.document_set: A named set of sources that a user can pick to narrow chat answers.
tables.document_chunks: One searchable passage of a document, cut by the chunker. The same passages are indexed in OpenSearch.
tables.documents: The extracted text of one file and its indexing state.
tables.stored_objects: Metadata of one file in MinIO object storage.
tables.chat_project: A project that groups conversations and files and adds its own instructions.
tables.chat_sharing: Whether a conversation can be read by other members through a share link.
tables.chat_settings: Chat rules for the whole tenant: history visibility, grounded answers and guardrails.
tables.chat_user_file: A file that a user uploaded or that the assistant created, kept in the personal library.
tables.chat_message: One message in a conversation. Messages form a tree, so an answer can be edited or regenerated.
tables.chat_feedback: A user's thumbs up or thumbs down on an answer, with an optional comment.
tables.llm_provider: An AI model provider set up by an administrator.
tables.ai_usage_limit: A token or cost budget for the tenant, a group or each person over a number of days.
tables.ai_usage: Daily totals of AI calls, tokens and cost for one user, flow and model.
tables.model_configuration: One model of a provider that users can pick, with its settings.
tables.meeting_speaker: A speaker label found in a meeting, with the name a user gave it.
tables.meeting_user_share: Shares a meeting with one member.
tables.mcp_server_group: Gives one group access to an MCP server.
tables.meeting_utterance: One piece of transcript with its speaker and time.
tables.meeting: A recorded or uploaded meeting with its transcript, minutes and processing state.
tables.mcp_credential: The token used to call an MCP server, either shared or for one user. The payload is encrypted.
tables.mcp_server: An external MCP server that chat can call tools from.
tables.meeting_minutes_item: One decision, action item or topic in the meeting minutes.
tables.meeting_group_share: Shares a meeting with one group.
tables.mcp_server_tool: One tool of an MCP server, with the policy for calling it.

columns.*.tenant_id: Owning tenant; part of every tenant-scoped key

columns.*.claim_token: Set when a worker claims the row
columns.*.lease_expires_at: Another worker may take over after this time
columns.*.error_code: Stable error code of the last failure
columns.*.delivery_id: Redis Streams delivery that carries the job

columns.*.dispatch_lease_expires_at: The job is sent again after this time
columns.*.next_dispatch_at: Earliest time to send the job
columns.*.deleted_at: Set when moved to the trash
